# File browser fixtures (spec 044, T040, T078)

Media for `scripts/e2e/scenarios/files-media.test.ts` (read through `scripts/e2e/lib/file-fixtures.ts`) and
documents for the text extraction of agents (`src-tauri/src/files/extract/`). Generated once from synthetic sources (test
pattern, sine tone, hand-written PDF), so they carry no third-party rights; CI does not need ffmpeg.

| File                                  | Content                                                                      | Made with                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `film.mp4`                            | 12 s, 320×240, H.264 baseline + AAC mono                                     | `ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc=size=320x240:rate=15:duration=12 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=12 -c:v libx264 -profile:v baseline -preset veryslow -crf 36 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 32k -ac 1 -movflags +faststart film.mp4` |
| `ton.mp3`                             | 10 s, 330 Hz sine, 64 kbit/s mono                                            | `ffmpeg -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=330:duration=10 -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 64k -ac 1 ton.mp3`                                                                                                                                                |
| `brief.pdf`                           | two pages, "Seite 1" / "Seite 2", Helvetica                                  | a short script writing the objects and the xref table by hand                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `steuer.pdf`                          | "Steuerbescheid 2025", "Das Finanzamt erstattet 312 Euro.", Helvetica        | Ghostscript `pdfwrite` from a three-line PostScript file                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `scan.pdf`                            | one page holding only an 8×8 image, no text and no font                      | Ghostscript `pdfwrite` from PostScript that draws the image with `image`                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `geschuetzt.pdf`                      | `steuer.pdf` encrypted (128 bit) with an owner password and no user password | Ghostscript `pdfwrite` with `-sOwnerPassword=geheim -sUserPassword= -dEncryptionR=3 -dKeyLength=128`                                                                                                                                      |
| `mietvertrag.docx`, `mietvertrag.odt` | "Mietvertrag Wohnung 3", "Die Miete beträgt 850 Euro im Monat."              | `soffice --headless --convert-to docx` / `odt` from a text file                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `tabelle.xlsx`, `tabelle.ods`         | sheets "Einnahmen" (Monat, Betrag; Januar, 1200) and "Ausgaben" (Miete, 850) | `soffice --headless --convert-to xlsx` / `ods` from a hand-written flat ODS                                                                                                                                                               |
